name: Meditate Among the Stones

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

text:
You spend an hour meditating within the ring of standing stones, absorbing the power they contain in an attempt to focus and sharpen your mind. At the end of the hour, attempt a DC 20 Will save save with the following results (this becomes a DC 25 Will save save if the standing stones haven't been cleared of fungus). Once you Meditate Among the Stones, you cannot attempt to do so again for 1 week, regardless of your results.

---
Critical Success Your mind sharpens and your thoughts clear. The next time you attempt an Intelligence-based skill check over the course of the following week, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

Effect: Meditate Among the Stones (Critical Success)

Success As critical success, but a +1 circumstance bonus, and the check must be made in the next 24 hours.

Effect: Meditate Among the Stones (Success)

Failure You meditate and relax, but achieve no enlightenment. If the stones haven't been cleared of fungus, treat this result instead as a critical failure.

Critical Failure As failure, but lingering influence from the Outer Rifts induces unnerving hallucinations that leave you Stupefied 1 for 24 hours.
